about:
Eureka Manufacturing Co. was founded in 1988 in Eureka, South Dakota. The company operates from a facility at 402 B Ave in Eureka, with a mailing address in Bismarck, North Dakota.

The company specializes in made-to-order steel and stainless steel fabrications for the commercial aquatics industry. Its capabilities include custom design, engineering, and fabrication of pool components such as movable swimming pool bulkheads, perimeter recirculation systems (gutters), swimming pool filters, anti-entrapment drain covers, sumps, access ramps, and water treatment systems. The shop also produces custom artistic metalwork and agricultural silos. To date, the firm has completed over 5,000 projects for more than 2,500 clients.

Eureka Manufacturing serves commercial aquatic facilities across the United States, Canadian provinces, Taiwan, and the Middle East. Its products are installed in public and commercial pools that must comply with the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool & Spa Safety Act.

The company emphasizes safety and quality by design, noting that its anti-entrapment drain covers are certified and stocked for immediate shipment. It also highlights a commitment to custom solutions and long-term client relationships.
